photos.c: Right: Ben Hamill had an 'off day', running after a bout of illness. He handed over to Wesley Swaffer who made up eight places for the U17 team. Wesley was voted Shepway Young Athlete of the Year for 1993 and has improved his best 1500m from 5:11.0 down to 4:32.9 in his first season.
